description: Returns today's snapshot of the tracked AI and semiconductor companies: breadth, the day's largest gains and losses, each segment's move, the reference ETFs (SMH, QQQ, IWM) and the market regime. `market` says whether the US session is open; when it is closed, the moves are those of the last session. Use it when the user asks how the sector is doing today. For market cap and volume over time, use get_market.
name: get_market_overview
title: Sector snapshot today
